effortless.procedural.tooltip.gradient_f: The colors show the selected spatial field before palette mapping. Drag the amber handle to move its center. Drag the cyan handle to set its direction and primary scale. Exact values remain available below.
effortless.procedural.tooltip.tab.form: Adjust the dimensions and behavior of the selected build form.
effortless.procedural.tooltip.tab.materi: Choose palette blocks and tune their contribution to the pattern.
effortless.procedural.tooltip.tab.previe: Inspect the generated pattern on a wall, floor, or cube.
effortless.procedural.tooltip.tab.tuning: Tune weights and per-block gradient or noise ranges.
effortless.procedural.tooltip.tab.mix: Combine sequence, gradient, and noise layers.
effortless.procedural.tooltip.tab.gradie: Shape and position the ordered gradient field.
effortless.procedural.tooltip.tab.noise: Tune deterministic fractal noise and domain warping.
effortless.procedural.tooltip.tab.rules: Apply adjacency, spacing, quota, and repair constraints.
effortless.procedural.tooltip.tab.masks: Control coordinate space and named spatial masks.
effortless.procedural.tooltip.tab.scene: Combine shapes, cutouts, trees, and path-repeated layers in a deterministic ordered scene.
effortless.procedural.tooltip.tab.road: Sweep this pattern along an editable curved centerline.
effortless.procedural.tooltip.tab.tree: Guide a species-aware tree using a base, crown, and optional branch points, with separate recipes for trunk, branches, leaves, and roots.
effortless.procedural.tooltip.tab.geomet: Reuse stock server-supported array, mirror, and radial transforms.
effortless.procedural.tooltip.tab.output: Configure seed, traversal, fallback, import, and export behavior.
effortless.procedural.tooltip.tool.featu: Selects a stock shape subtype for the active in-world tool. This is saved in the normal client structure configuration.
effortless.procedural.tooltip.value.grad: Progress along a generator path, such as a branch root to its tip.
Generator-defined position across or between structural regions.
Distance from a structural centerline: zero at the core and one at the shell.
Normalized local width, from thin twigs or edges to thick structural sections.
How strongly the local surface tapers or changes height.
Proximity to the end of a path: zero along its body and one at the endpoint.
Proximity to a structural connection where several paths meet.
effortless.procedural.tooltip.structural: Random preserves palette weights. Smart protects cores and junctions, uses stairs and slabs on sloped shells, and keeps connectors near thin tips. Rule driven uses Path, Depth, Thickness, Slope, Tip, and Junction masks without automatic weighting.
effortless.procedural.tooltip.setting.sp: Loads a complete cross-section preset. Editing a dimension afterward changes the subtype to Custom.
effortless.procedural.tooltip.value.spli: A narrow one-layer walking path with no shoulders.
A level paved surface with shoulders and a supporting layer.
Raises the center so the road slopes gently toward both edges.
Tilts the complete cross-section across the curve.
Widens each lower foundation layer to form a stable sloped base.
Lowers the travel surface between raised side shoulders.
A broad elevated deck intended for separate curb and foundation recipes.
A narrow ballast bed with a center track lane. Vanilla and Create track states follow straight, sloped, and diagonal tangents; Create Bezier connections must still be placed with Create.
Keeps the current width, depth, shoulders, tension, and sample precision.
effortless.procedural.tooltip.setting.sp: Assign saved recipes to the surface, shoulders, foundation, curbs, markings, and damage. Each link reuses that recipe's palette and rules.
effortless.procedural.tooltip.setting.tr: Assign saved recipes independently to trunk, branches, foliage, and roots.
effortless.procedural.tooltip.action.cho: Choose a saved recipe for this material region.
effortless.procedural.tooltip.action.use: Use the current recipe for this material region.
Link the highlighted recipe to this material region.
effortless.procedural.spline.damage_hint: Damage is an overlay: Skip preserves the base surface, blocks replace it, and Eraser selects cells for clearing or a configured cutout volume.
effortless.procedural.tooltip.spline.geo: Build ordered curbs, borders, slopes, sidewalks, trenches, and deep damage volumes without increasing the road foundation depth.
Bands are appended from the base road edge outward in list order. Each band has independent width, height, depth, side, placement shape, and material recipe.
Turns Eraser cells selected by the Damage recipe into an explicit hole below the road. Unselected cells under the road are not generated.
Sets the hole depth independently from the base road thickness.
Contracts the selected footprint as the hole gets deeper. Zero keeps vertical sides; one removes one horizontal block ring per layer.
Choose separate recipes for the cutout walls and floor. Blank links reuse the main spline recipe.
effortless.procedural.spline.band.title: Edit cross-section band
effortless.procedural.spline.band.name: Band name
effortless.procedural.tooltip.spline.ban: Horizontal blocks measured outward from the preceding band or the base road edge.
Vertical offset relative to the spline surface. Positive values rise; negative values descend.
Vertical fill depth for this band only.
Orients stairs inward or outward and chooses top or bottom slab states from spline geometry. Full blocks ignore this hint.
Links a saved pattern to this band. A blank link uses the main spline pattern.
effortless.tooltip.composition.stack: Ordered scene layers combine shapes, trees, and saved material recipes. Later layers may add, replace, cut, preserve, or intersect earlier output.
effortless.tooltip.composition.enabled: Disabled layers remain saved but do not affect preview or placement.
effortless.tooltip.composition.operation: Union adds missing cells. Replace also changes overlaps. Subtract emits Eraser cells. Skip preserves the world. Intersect keeps only shared cells.
effortless.tooltip.composition.generator: Primitive voxelizes the selected shape. Tree runs the selected recipe's tree generator and component palettes.
effortless.tooltip.composition.anchor: Bounds anchors use the current scene. Path uses only the original spline, Generated Path uses tree limbs made by earlier layers, and All Paths uses both.
effortless.tooltip.composition.shape: Select box, ellipsoid, cylinder, cone, arch, dome, wedge, diamond, pyramid, or torus geometry for a Primitive layer.
effortless.tooltip.composition.recipe: Select the recipe that supplies materials, rules, and tree settings. Its own scene stack is excluded to prevent recursive expansion.
effortless.tooltip.composition.offset: Moves each instance from its anchor. On a path, X moves sideways, Y moves vertically, and Z moves forward along the path.
effortless.tooltip.composition.size: Primitive dimensions in blocks. Large dimensions are still bounded by client safety and server clipboard limits.
effortless.tooltip.composition.rotation: Rotates primitive geometry around its vertical axis. On paths, zero aligns the local forward direction with the path tangent.
effortless.tooltip.composition.hollow: Keeps only the outer shell of a primitive instead of filling its interior.
effortless.tooltip.composition.shell: Thickness of a hollow primitive's retained outer shell.
effortless.tooltip.composition.spacing: Distance between Path-anchored instances. Each independent generated branch is spaced separately.
effortless.tooltip.composition.instances: Hard cap on instances created by this layer. It prevents accidental path explosions.
effortless.tooltip.composition.seed: Stable salt mixed into generated tree variants. Change it to obtain another deterministic arrangement.
effortless.tooltip.composition.variation: Varies repeated trees within the selected tree recipe's safe ranges while remaining deterministic.
